# Presenter inset over the product tour

Ten seconds of the product tour with Mira from the talking-head edit as a small inset in the top-left corner, so the dashboard stays the main picture and her voice narrates it.

- Type: Picture in picture
- Skill: `magnifito-edit`
- Engine: `pip`
- Output: 1920x1080, 10 s, with audio
- Video: [`../videos/f16-picture-in-picture.mp4`](../videos/f16-picture-in-picture.mp4)
- Footage: synthetic, generated by the commands below. No camera footage is used.

## Recreate it with Claude Code

Install the plugin (see the repository README), open this folder, and give Claude this prompt:

> Put Mira from ../videos/03-talking-head-edit.mp4 (from 2.5 s, head and shoulders only, no captions or edit bar) as a picture-in-picture inset over ../videos/02-product-demo.mp4 (from 4 s to 14 s). Top-left corner, 400 px wide, so it stays clear of the caption pill and the Share report button. Use her voice as the soundtrack.

## Recreate it by hand

From the repository root, one command renders this example exactly as committed:

```sh
npm run showcase -- f16-picture-in-picture
```

Or run the steps yourself from `showcase/f16-picture-in-picture/` (after `npm run build && npm link`):

```sh
ffmpeg -ss 4 -t 10 -i ../videos/02-product-demo.mp4 -ss 2.5 -t 10 -i ../videos/03-talking-head-edit.mp4 -map 0:v -map 1:a -c:v libx264 -crf 16 -preset medium -c:a aac -b:a 160k work/main.mp4
ffmpeg -ss 2.5 -t 10 -i ../videos/03-talking-head-edit.mp4 -an -vf crop=680:640:620:130 -c:v libx264 -crf 16 -preset medium work/presenter.mp4
mgvideo pip work/main.mp4 work/presenter.mp4 --corner top_left --width 400 --out work/pip.mp4
```

The finished file is `work/pip.mp4`. The config files in this folder are the inputs.
